meta.name: dr-init
meta.description: Initialize new Darkroom project from a satus or novus starter (NOT the same as native /init which writes CLAUDE.md). Triggers "new darkroom project", "satus", "novus", "scaffold from starter".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从 satus 或 novus 模板初始化新 Darkroom 项目
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果要快速生成 Darkroom 项目骨架
copy.tagline_en: Initialize a new Darkroom project from satus or novus starter
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to scaffold a Darkroom project from a starter template

howto.what: 该技能会引导你创建一个新的 Darkroom 项目，可选择 satus（Next.js）或 novus（React Router）starter，然后自动克隆仓库、安装依赖、配置环境变量，并启动开发服务器。
howto.when: 当你提到“新 Darkroom 项目”、“satus”、“novus”等关键词，或要求从 starter 脚手架创建项目时触发。

say.text: 我用 novus 创建一个 SPA 项目，命名 my-app。
我想初始化一个 react-router 的 Darkroom 项目。

howto.what_en: This skill guides Claude to initialize a new Darkroom project using either satus (Next.js) or novus (React Router) starter. It clones the repo, installs dependencies, configures environment, and starts the dev server.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'new Darkroom project', 'satus', 'novus', or request to scaffold from a starter.

say_en.text: Create a new Darkroom project with satus, named my-website.
I want a SPA project with novus, named my-app.
Initialize a Darkroom project using react-router.
